title: Healthcare & Medical Privacy Risk Calculator
metaDescription: Assess your medical privacy risks with health apps, telehealth, and HIPAA compliance. Get personalized recommendations to protect your health data.
description: Calculate your healthcare privacy risk level based on your health app usage, telehealth practices, and data sharing habits. Get personalized recommendations to better protect your sensitive medical information from unauthorized access and data breaches.

inputs.label: Number of health/fitness apps you use regularly
inputs.helpText: Include fitness trackers, period trackers, symptom checkers, mental health apps, etc.

inputs.label: How often do you review health app privacy policies?
inputs.helpText: Privacy policies reveal how apps collect, use, and share your health data

inputs.label: Telehealth usage frequency
inputs.helpText: Video calls, phone consultations, or messaging with healthcare providers

inputs.label: Do you allow health apps to share data with third parties?
inputs.helpText: Check app settings for data sharing options and permissions

inputs.label: Types of sensitive health data you track digitally
inputs.helpText: More sensitive data creates higher privacy risks if breached

inputs.label: Privacy protection measures you currently use
inputs.helpText: Security measures help reduce your overall privacy risk

outputFields.label: Healthcare Privacy Risk Score
outputFields.description: Your overall medical privacy risk level out of 100

outputFields.label: Risk Category
outputFields.description: Low, Moderate, High, or Critical risk assessment

outputFields.label: Priority Actions
outputFields.description: Number of recommended actions to improve your privacy

formula: const appRisk = { '0': 0, '1-3': 15, '4-6': 25, '7-10': 35, '10+': 45 }[healthApps] || 20; const policyRisk = { 'always': 0, 'sometimes': 10, 'rarely': 20, 'never': 30 }[appPrivacy] || 25; const telehealthRisk = { 'never': 0, 'rarely': 5, 'monthly': 10, 'weekly': 15 }[telehealthFreq] || 10; const sharingRisk = { 'no': 0, 'limited': 5, 'yes': 25, 'unknown': 20 }[dataSharing] || 20; const dataRisk = { 'none': 0, 'basic': 5, 'moderate': 15, 'extensive': 25 }[sensitiveData] || 15; const securityBonus = { 'none': 0, 'basic': -5, 'moderate': -15, 'advanced': -25 }[securityMeasures] || 0; const rawScore = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, appRisk + policyRisk + telehealthRisk + sharingRisk + dataRisk + securityBonus)); const riskLevel = rawScore <= 25 ? 'Low Risk': rawScore <= 50 ? 'Moderate Risk': rawScore <= 75 ? 'High Risk': 'Critical Risk'; const recommendations = rawScore <= 25 ? 2: rawScore <= 50 ? 4: rawScore <= 75 ? 6: 8; return { riskScore: rawScore, riskLevel: riskLevel, recommendations: recommendations };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates your healthcare privacy risk by analyzing your digital health habits, app usage patterns, data sharing practices, and security measures. It considers factors like the number of health apps you use, how you handle privacy policies, telehealth security, and the sensitivity of data you track digitally.
tips: Review privacy policies of all health apps before installation and annually thereafter
Use a privacy-focused browser when researching sensitive health topics to avoid tracking
Enable two-factor authentication on all health-related accounts and apps
Regularly audit app permissions and disable unnecessary data sharing options
Consider using a VPN when accessing telehealth services on public networks

interpretation.label: Low Risk
interpretation.description: Good privacy practices with minimal exposure. Continue monitoring and stay informed about new threats.

interpretation.label: Moderate Risk
interpretation.description: Some privacy vulnerabilities exist. Review app permissions and consider reducing data sharing.

interpretation.label: High Risk
interpretation.description: Significant privacy concerns. Immediate action needed to secure your health data and review all apps.

interpretation.label: Critical Risk
interpretation.description: Urgent privacy vulnerabilities. Consider removing non-essential apps and implementing strong security measures immediately.
